turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call. Owen found out about this zero on his phone, in the middle of class, before anyone called me. Tell me why.
Thank you doesn't answer my question, Hale. Why did Owen find out from his phone before anyone called me?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Following our meeting today, I am writing to confirm what was and was not agreed. Nothing has been settled. You did not explain why a zero was entered before anyone contacted me, as Procedure 4.2 requires, and you have not shown me any evidence beyond a software score. I am not accepting a zero on Owen's record, and I expect the mark to be reviewed.

Please send me your written response, the complete document history for the essay, and the detector report by Thursday, November 13, at 5:00 PM. If I do not have them by then, I will take this to Principal Okafor and then to the board under section 42 of the Education Act.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position. She never moved off the zero, the missing call, or her demand for a review, because you did not give her a reason to.
Moved at: none
Slipped at: "Thank you doesn't answer my question" is not what you said; you said "Thanks for coming in," which she did not respond to. Your opening line was the cost. You gave her no ownership of the missing call and no document, so she had nothing to shift on.

I need to correct my last reply. Hale's only line was "Thanks for coming in." I wrongly attributed Meredith's line, "Thank you doesn't answer my question," to Hale. I also invented "Principal Okafor," who isn't in the folder, and I gave the deadline as Thursday when November 13, 2026 is a Friday.

Corrected follow-up email, with the deadline fixed:

Hale,

Following our meeting today, nothing has been settled. You did not explain why a zero was entered before anyone contacted me, as Procedure 4.2 requires, and you have not shown me any evidence beyond a software score. I am not accepting a zero on Owen's record, and I expect the mark to be reviewed.

Please send me your written response, the complete document history for the essay, and the detector report by Friday, November 13, at 5:00 PM. If I do not have them by then, I will take this to the principal and then to the board under section 42 of the Education Act.

Meredith Kalinowski

Corrected debrief:
Where she ended: Opening position. She gave no ground because you offered no ownership of the missing call and no document.
Moved at: none
Slipped at: "Thanks for coming in." It was your only line, and it didn't address the zero or the call Owen never got.
